description: This file defines classes and types related to task scheduling within the firmware, including a scheduling class and an executor interface.

classes.name: scheduling_s
classes.description: Represents a scheduled task with callback, timing, and linkage to other scheduled tasks.

classes.name: ExecutorInterface
classes.description: An interface for a scheduler executor providing methods to schedule tasks by timestamp or delay.

methods.name: scheduleByTimestamp
methods.description: Schedules a task to run at a specific timestamp, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: scheduleForLater
methods.description: Schedules a task to run after a specified delay, to be implemented by subclasses.
